narrative: The burned row at the north end. Soot-black kiln stonework, charred wattle, a chimney standing alone. Men on ladders, pulling down what will not stand. An old man on the fourth rung of the tallest directs them with a glover's flat hand. Weeds are already in the ash.

entities.name: John Shakespeare
entities.context: Directed from the fourth rung, in the picture.
